news.title: ICYMI: Rosen’s Carson City Lands Bill Passes Senate
U.S. Senate approves Carson City public lands bill

timeline.text: The House received a message from the Clerk. Pursuant to the permission granted in Clause 2(h) of Rule II of the Rules of the U.S. House of Representatives, the Clerk notified the House that he had received the following message from the Secretary of the Senate on November 16, 2026, at 4:44 p.m.: That the Senate passed S. 432, S. 1353, S. 2887, S. 3493, and H.R. 2400 amended.
timeline.label: Passage
timeline.explain: The real vote on the measure itself.

timeline.text: Message on Senate action sent to the House.
timeline.label: Update

timeline.text: Passed Senate with an amendment by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S5666-5667; text: CR S5667-5668)
timeline.label: Amendment
timeline.explain: A vote on a proposed change, not on the bill itself.

timeline.text: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 488.
timeline.label: Placed on the calendar

timeline.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Reported by Senator Lee with an amendment in the nature of a substitute. Without written report.
timeline.label: Committee action

timeline.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
timeline.label: Committee action

timeline.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources Subcommittee on Public Lands, Forests, and Mining. Hearings held. With printed Hearing: S.Hrg. 119-305.
timeline.label: Committee action

timeline.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
timeline.label: Introduced / sent to committee
